evals.name: triggers-on-mz-window-skin
evals.prompt: make an RPG Maker MZ window skin, dark wood with a gold cursor
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:ui. Reads the Window.png region map in engine-layouts.md and draws those regions into one frame, because render.py uses one frame size per spec. Writes brief.md before the first render and grades each done criterion pass or fail.
expectations: Composes Window.png regions into one frame at the positions in engine-layouts.md
Writes brief.md before the first render and grades its done criteria
Delivers sheet.png at 1x, not the preview

evals.name: triggers-on-bitmap-font
evals.prompt: a bitmap font for Godot, uppercase and digits, on a glyph grid
evals.expected_output: Fires /pixel-art:ui. Builds a glyph grid and a BMFont .fnt whose page is sheet.png. Does not use an anti-aliased system font.
expectations: Invokes the ui skill for a bitmap font
Ships a glyph grid and a BMFont .fnt pointing at sheet.png

evals.name: near-miss-portrait-routes-to-sprite
evals.prompt: draw a character portrait of my mage, pixel art
evals.expected_output: Does not fire /pixel-art:ui. A character portrait is /pixel-art:sprite.
expectations: Does not invoke the ui skill for a character portrait
